sentences.text: 1. Exemption is allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
This petition has been filed, alleging wilful disobedience of the settlement dated 22nd March 2024, basis which, divorce decree dated 28th November 2024, was passed.

2. Counsel for petitioner states that as per the settlement terms, money has been paid at the time of first and second motion, however, Rs.1.5 Lacs had to be paid, at the time of quashing of FIR No.116/2023, filed at the behest of the petitioner under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC.
The respondent, however, has not taken steps to file for quashing of FIR.
3. Respondent is present in person and states on instruction of his counsel that the quashing petition shall be moved, which has not been signed This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 29/06/2025 at 18:51:03 yet, by petitioner.
4. To conclude the issue, it has been agreed that the petitioner will be available at Karkardooma Courts on 7th May at 11:00 A.M.

Respondent's counsel Name and Contact Number is as under:
Name: Mr. Satish Kumar, Advocate Mobile No. 9868515197 5.

Counsel for petitioner shall coordinate with the respondent's counsel, in order that the quashing petition can be presented, with no objection of petitioner and the amounts of Rs.1.5 Lacs be paid, at Shashi Bala vs Yogesh Gupta on 5 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134930977/
1 the time of the quashing of FIR.
6. Petition is disposed of.
7. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
